text.p: Portuguese cash bonds and futures closed lower as the French left's weekend election victory continued to weigh on prices.

Dealers said June futures were hovering dangerously close to key support levels but they said short bonds had good support and the market seemed reluctant to widen the 10-year yield spread with Bunds beyond 55 basis points.
"Futures have support at between 108.50 and 108.75 but if they fall through 108.50 the drop to 108.00 will be pretty swift," said one dealer.
"The victory of the left in France was a shock and it has hit 10-year bonds but it is a false assumption to say that the single currency will now be delayed," said another dealer.
Dealers said investors would wait for the result of tomorrow's five-year bond auction and for London and New York openings tomorrow to gauge direction.
French franc fragility kept the escudo under pressure. The currency ended at 101.12/15 per mark, little changed from its opening but down from Friday's 100.95/98.
Currency traders expected further falls on Tuesday but said the Bank of Portugal would intervene to limit the damage.
